name: PP-19 BIZON
description:
The PP-19 Bizon is a 9mm submachine gun developed in the mid-1990s by Izhmash made famous by its huge, cylindrical magazine. The Bizon is capable of decent damage up-close, but falls off considerably at range despite its huge magazine. It also comes in both 9x19mm and 9x18mm from the factory.
Kept ya' waiting, huh?
